summary_rationale: GNA Axles Limited is an established, creditworthy ([ICRA]AA- Stable / [ICRA]A1+) Tier-1 manufacturer of forged and precision-machined rear axle shafts (~74% of mix), spindles (~17%), and drive shafts (~9%) serving commercial vehicles, off-highway tractors, and light vehicles/SUVs across domestic (~53%) and export (~47%) markets. Its integrated Mehtiana and Gulabgarh Jattan plants in Punjab enjoy multi-year OEM qualification moats with global Tier-1s (Dana, Meritor/Cummins, John Deere, Mahindra, TAFE), low net debt (borrowings of ₹203 Cr vs ₹1,074 Cr net worth as of Sep 2026), and a sharp H1 FY27 operational rebound (Q1 FY27 sales +37% YoY to ₹470 Cr; Q2 FY27 sales +50% YoY to ₹521 Cr). However, the business is structurally cyclical rather than a steady compounder: FY23 peak sales (₹1,583 Cr) were followed by three flat-to-down years (FY24-FY26), 10-year ROCE has remained modest at 14%-21% (14.3% in FY26; ROE 12.2%), top-10 customer concentration sits at ~79%-80%, debtor days have stretched to 151 days (working capital cycle 133 days), and promoter shareholding fell 9.96 percentage points between Mar 2026 (68.43%) and Sep 2026 (58.47%) due to promoter-group open-market sales.
